scope: Headless Edge, isolated localhost HTTP server, MemoryStore and synthetic administrator; no cloud writes or real password changes.
checks: Current-password error remains in the dialog, clears the incorrect field and preserves the authenticated workspace.
Mismatched confirmation is rejected before the network; Escape closes and reopening clears all passwords.
Desktop, 390px light and 320px dark layouts have no horizontal overflow, overlapping header controls, or clipped dialog actions.
While saving, duplicate submission/cancellation are blocked; success clears the form, logs out both browser contexts and explains reauthentication.
The old password fails and an exactly eight-digit new password signs in successfully without character-combination rules.
